scope: One frozen nominal PPO policy, 10 shared physical starts, one mechanism changed per condition. Simulation sensitivity probes, not measured hardware tolerances or variation across training seeds.

command_delay_ms.label: Actuator target queue
command_delay_ms.interpretation: Fixed 5 ms physics-frame delay. Held 20 ms control decisions can be older than the selected queue frame.

observation_delay_ms.label: IMU and joint-velocity history
observation_delay_ms.interpretation: Fixed requested lag at 20 ms observation cadence. Maintained IMU/velocity buffers have their own reset and startup phases.

noise_scale.label: Actor observation noise
noise_scale.interpretation: Independent additive uniform components at each actor-observation computation. Scale multiplies gyro 0.03 rad/s, projected gravity 0.01, joint position 0.001 rad and joint velocity 0.25 rad/s bounds. Critic remains uncorrupted.

voltage.label: Fixed BAM supply
voltage.interpretation: Fixed simulated actuator supply; dynamic battery sag disabled. No battery or board measurement is inferred.

encoder_bias_rad.label: Shared servo encoder calibration bias
encoder_bias_rad.interpretation: Same signed constant on all 14 servo encoders. The maintained biased action term adds it to actor joint-position readings and subtracts it from physical joint targets; this is not an observation-only intervention.

backlash.label: Authored gearbox-play asset
backlash.interpretation: Selects 14 passive series hinges with authored stops at plus/minus 1 degree and the documented additional 14 mg authored mass. This is a discrete asset intervention, not a continuously swept clearance.

evaluation.outcomes: Retain all trials, including falls and invalid attempts; distinguish survival from command response. Nominal baseline is evaluated once and shared across all six views.
